bench_test_protocol.goal: Calibrate joint, fingertip force, object-pose, and button sensors before contact.
bench_test_protocol.pass_fail: No emergency stop, no joint-limit violation, and timestamp gaps below 20 ms.
bench_test_protocol.procedure: Run the seed-42 no-object pose envelope for 10 seconds with motors torque-limited.

bench_test_protocol.goal: Confirm the velocity-servo controller can replay the five-phase trajectory safely.
bench_test_protocol.pass_fail: Controller completes all five phases with zero runtime pose teleports.
bench_test_protocol.procedure: Replay the exported policy trace with the vial fixture removed and a soft palm stop installed.

bench_test_protocol.goal: Validate five-finger contact on a foam or capped dummy vial before torque loading.
bench_test_protocol.pass_fail: All five fingertips contact the vial and measured slip stays below 0.5 mm.
bench_test_protocol.procedure: Run vial-grasp phase only, then hold for 3 seconds under low fingertip force.

bench_test_protocol.goal: Transfer the 220 degree cap-rotation task to a torque-limited real vial fixture.
bench_test_protocol.pass_fail: Cap rotation reaches at least 220 degrees with no contact-force or velocity-limit fault.
bench_test_protocol.procedure: Use a breakaway cap or torque proxy, ramp command speed, and stop at the first slip alarm.

bench_test_protocol.goal: Check recovery after a controlled lateral tap on the vial during grasp.
bench_test_protocol.pass_fail: Peak slip remains at or below 0.5 mm and the vial returns to the grasp corridor.
bench_test_protocol.procedure: Apply a repeatable 2 mm fixture perturbation and replay the recovery phase.

bench_test_protocol.goal: Verify vial, cap, capsule, bandage, and tool token can be staged into labeled slots.
bench_test_protocol.pass_fail: Every final slot error is 10 mm or lower, with a preferred 5 mm judge target.
bench_test_protocol.procedure: Use AprilTag or fixture-frame object tracking and run the placement phase at half speed.

bench_test_protocol.goal: Validate final index-button confirmation and the operator abort path.
bench_test_protocol.pass_fail: Index button press is recorded, and E-stop latency is below 100 ms in the dry-run drill.
bench_test_protocol.procedure: Press the confirmation button once, then deliberately trip the E-stop on a separate dry run.

claim: Hardware-transfer protocol responding to judge feedback; this is a real-robot bench plan generated from simulation evidence, not a completed physical experiment.
hardware_validation_gaps: Physical robot execution is still pending.
Camera/depth perception is still simulated or fixture-based in the current package.
Force limits must be calibrated on the target hand before any live cap-rotation trial.
safety_interlocks: Stop if any fingertip force exceeds 8 N for more than 100 ms.
Stop if measured slip exceeds 3 mm before the recovery phase is active.
Stop if cap torque proxy or motor current exceeds the configured hardware limit.
Stop if object pose leaves the tray fixture corridor by more than 25 mm.
Stop immediately on operator E-stop or missing telemetry for more than 100 ms.

target_platform.control_interface: velocity-servo or low-level joint command interface with force/current limits
target_platform.embodiment: five-finger dexterous hand with thumb opposition and MCP/PIP/DIP-like joints

telemetry_schema.purpose: Align robot commands, contact samples, and pass/fail events.
Verify MCP/PIP/DIP-like finger motion follows the exported trajectory envelope.
Enforce velocity limits during cap rotation, recovery, and button press.
Replay calibrated tactile residuals without direct pose teleports.
Confirm thumb, index, middle, ring, and little-finger contact on the vial and cap.
Measure vial, cap, capsule, bandage, and tool-token placement.
Score the 220 degree cap-rotation objective on hardware.
Detect perturbation recovery failures before the object leaves the safe fixture.
Score final medkit tray placement against slot markers.
Record every software or operator safety stop.
